answer: The mesa lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the tundra is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the comet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
